rows.name: Koopa Troopa (green, walking left)
rows.notes:
World 1-1's single Koopa Troopa, the green-shelled turtle, paused while walking left on the ground at level x≈1695 (camera x=1514). PROOF: list_sprites (paused, game_mode $0770=1) decodes a 6-entry OAM group at slots 40-45, origin (181,185) = top-left of a 16x24 metasprite (2 tiles wide x 3 tall), all sprite palette 5, all flip_h = true (attr $41), none behind_background, sprite pattern table $0000. Entries as (tile id, x/y offset from origin, flips, palette):
- $A0 (160), (+0,+0), flip_h, palette 5 — upper-left (head)
- $FC (252), (+8,+0), flip_h, palette 5 — upper-right, blank filler (this corner of the 16x24 form is empty)
- $A2 (162), (+0,+8), flip_h, palette 5 — middle-left (shell)
- $A1 (161), (+8,+8), flip_h, palette 5 — middle-right (shell)
- $A4 (164), (+0,+16), flip_h, palette 5 — lower-left (foot)
- $A3 (163), (+8,+16), flip_h, palette 5 — lower-right (foot)
All six entries carry flip_h because the Koopa walks left, so the engine mirrors the whole group (the base layout without flips is its right-facing form). Sprite palette 5 live = [15,26,48,39] = [$0F black, $1A green, $30 white, $27 orange]: the shell renders $1A green, the body/feet $27 orange, the eye/belly $30 white. HIT-TEST: list_sprites at (185,196) returned OAM index 42, tile $A2, palette 5, pixel_value 3 (opaque); get_pixel_color (185,196) = $27 orange (index 3) and (192,197) = $1A green (index 1), matching palette 5. REACH: from a clean World 1-1 start, write CPU $079F = 200 (star invincibility; counts down ~1 per 20 frames, so it covers the walk) and play right holding B with a jump pulse about every 40 frames; the Koopa spawns once the camera reaches page 6 (camera x >= 1536) essentially alongside Mario, so approach in a short run and pause the moment it appears — with the star off Mario would instead die on it, and touching it with the star on turns it into a sliding shell (tiles $6E/$6F) instead of the walking metasprite above.
rows.why: the green Koopa Troopa at the right of this screenshot; OAM $A0 (head) with a $FC filler over $A2/$A1 and $A4/$A3, all h-flipped, palette 5: rendered from sprite CHR they are the Koopa's other walking frame (the same shell, the feet in the other step; r1 and r2 caught $A5-$A9)
